findings.title: Missing task for the children's corner
findings.detail: The plan describes a children's corner with colouring and a book swap, but no task is listed to organise it, assign an owner, or set a duration.
findings.quote: a small children's corner with colouring and a book swap.

findings.title: Event date is relative only
findings.detail: The deadline is 21 days after the kickoff meeting, but the kickoff meeting date is not given, so the actual calendar date cannot be determined.
findings.quote: The market is on a Saturday, 21 days after our kickoff meeting

findings.title: On-day clearing and stacking has no owner
findings.detail: The plan says the rooms will be cleared and tables stacked by 5pm, but does not name who is responsible for this work.
findings.quote: The caretaker locks up at 5pm, by which time the rooms will be cleared and the tables stacked.
